subject: C42
required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/v2/academy/academy.tsx:117,519-530,615-637: Your place is evaluated inside a memoized router component through placeRef. Updating the ref does not rerender that component. A same-generation snapshot update can change the account pill while leaving the name and saved-draft count in Your place stale. An in-memory probe of the production component reproduced an updated pill, the old sidebar name, and no draft note after localDrafts changed from zero to one. Make this content react to snapshot updates without recreating the learner session or losing the route. Acceptance: same-generation rerenders update the name and add/change/remove the draft note while preserving the current learner page.

R2 — apps/desktop/src/v2/academy/academy.tsx:301-306: Learning paths creates a second paths.list cache under ['v2','academy','paths',learner]. Academy's progress-reset/enrollment hooks invalidate the tRPC paths.list key, which does not match this namespace. Consequently the hosted page can refresh while the always-mounted cards retain old unitsDone/progress. A local query/component probe confirmed the row stayed at 1 of 4 after the server value became 2 and paths.list was invalidated. Integrate the row with the learner query/invalidation lifecycle. Acceptance: a successful course-progress reset and subsequent progress changes refresh the cards for the same generation without remounting Academy or switching accounts.

R3 — apps/desktop/src/v2/academy/academy.test.tsx:87-95 and tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c42.py:266-272: both navigation checks accept disappearance of the catalog as successful path navigation. The Vitest fixture supplies courses instead of the shared page's required sections; the retained vitest.log records a PathLandingPage flatMap TypeError while that test passes. The native catalog supplies no paths.get response, and tree-academy-path.json explicitly contains 'Path not found.' despite C42-N01 passing. Supply contract-shaped successful path responses, assert the requested path title/content and exact pathSlug, reject error/not-found states, and regenerate the affected tests and native acceptance evidence.
